description: Stories with filters. `ticker` matches TSP's ticker tags (BTC, ETH, SOL…). `topic` matches a Moon Catcher Wire topic (see mcw-list-topics) — these are OUR keyword rules, not TSP's, because TSP has no topic model. `since_hours` bounds by publication time. `breaking_only` keeps just the high-impact wires. `matched` counts every match; an answer carries up to 20 of them (`limit`), from `offset`. `has_more` is true when matches remain, and `next_offset` is where the next page starts.

offset.description: How many of the matching stories to skip, strongest first; with limit, a page of them.

topic.description: a topic slug, e.g. crypto or ai

name: mcw-list-stories
